item.title: What Proverbs Teaches Parents About Raising Wise Children
item.description: The book of Proverbs is one of God’s most practical gifts to parents. In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains what Proverbs teaches about biblical parenting, shaping a child’s heart, forming character, and guiding children toward the fear of the Lord.

item.title: Psalm 10 — When Evil Seems to Win, God Still Sees
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks verse by verse through Psalm 10, addressing the prosperity of the wicked and the suffering of the helpless while pointing to God’s perfect justice and compassion.

item.title: Guarding Your Home with Biblical Discernment
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains how Christians can guard their homes with biblical discernment in a culture filled with confusion, compromise, and constant digital influence. Drawing from Scripture, he shows why discernment begins with the heart and how families can cultivate holy boundaries without legalism.

item.title: The Creator–Creation Distinction and Why It Matters in Responding to New Age Beliefs
item.description: Why the Creator–creation distinction matters for Christian discernment and responding to New Age beliefs like crystals, astrology, pantheism, and panentheism. Key Scriptures: Romans 1:25; Isaiah 45:5; John 17:3.

item.title: Psalm 11: When the Foundations Shake, God Still Reigns
item.description: Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 11 and explains how believers can stand firm when everything feels unstable. This episode highlights God's sovereignty, holiness, righteous judgment, and the believer's secure refuge in Christ.

item.title: Walking by the Spirit: A Life Shaped by God’s Word
item.description: In this episode of Anchored in the Word, Dave Jenkins explains what it means to walk by the Spirit according to Scripture. Drawing from Galatians 5, Romans 8, and John 16, this teaching shows how the Holy Spirit shapes daily Christian living through obedience to God’s Word.
